pairs.evidence: app/features/shell/companion/CompanionDockBody.tsx:189 The dock decides whether an answer 'was written to memory' from the index-lane skip list, not from whether the episode document landed. append_episode records the optional Personas lane as skipped whenever the desktop app's DB is absent, which the docs call normal, so on a kp-only install every turn prints 'This answer was not written to memory.' even though the markdown episode and the brain-local index (the only lane recall reads) were both written.

techniques.evidence: app/features/shell/companion/CompanionDockBody.tsx:189 The check on the self reads index-lane status, not the document. Any skipped optional lane (the Personas DB absent, which companion_brain.py raises as FileNotFoundError into `skipped`) is shown as a memory-write failure.

app/features/shell/companion/CompanionDockBody.tsx:232 Memoryless mode is stated in one quiet line from its own payload field (memoryEnabled), and the line names where the switch is ('turn it on in setup').
app/features/shell/companion/CompanionDockProvider.tsx:47 Dock, voice strip and control-dock input share one thread created above them, so no surface owns a private conversation store.

app/features/shell/companion/CompanionProposalCard.tsx:16 Proposal cards carry world actions from the catalog, not self-model edits. Searching the repo found no write path to identity.md other than ensure_brain's seed skeleton.

pairs.evidence: app/api/companion/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:140 When an accepted companion action fails, the route puts the proposal back to open and leaves only a server log line. A broken capability therefore leaves no durable evidence and cannot be told apart from one never tried, and no ledger anywhere tracks working, broken and unexercised per catalog action.

techniques.evidence: app/api/companion/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:140 The executor is the one place real exercises happen. Success is stamped per proposal and failure is erased back to 'open', so 'when did it stop' cannot be answered and there is no three-state record.
app/api/companion/brain/route.ts:78 The disk is re-probed at execution, birth runs before the consent stamp, there is no 'decline' action (lines 29-32), and consent is recorded per workspace.
